item.title: 8 Heartburn Remedies for Fast Relief
item.description: Just because heartburn is common doesn’t mean you have to suffer with it. Left untreated, frequent acid reflux can develop into more serious health problems.

item.title: How to Treat Nail Damage From Psoriatic Arthritis
item.description: Psoriatic arthritis can cause nail problems ranging from mild to severe. Here’s how to spot the signs and what to do.

item.title: Knee Osteoarthritis
item.description: Explore the symptoms and causes of knee osteoarthritis, a progressive disease that wears away the cartilage of the knee joint. Learn about lifestyle changes, medication, and surgery to manage this common condition effectively.

item.title: The Case for Medical Weight Loss Programs and Intensive Lifestyle Change
item.description: Whether or not you take GLP-1 weight loss drugs, medically prescribed programs to help manage lifestyle factors can help you drop pounds and keep them off.

item.title: 7 Ways to Live Happier and Healthier if You Have Crohn’s Disease
item.description: Diet, exercise, and lifestyle tips to help you manage Crohn’s disease.

item.title: How to Manage Hypertension With Early-Stage Alzheimer’s
item.description: Learn how to safely manage hypertension with early-stage Alzheimer’s, with tips for simplifying your medication, monitoring blood pressure at home, and using lifestyle changes like the MIND diet and exercise to protect your brain health.

item.title: What Is ‘Somatic Shaking,’ and Can It Really Reduce Stress?
item.description: People on social media say a few minutes of fast, energetic movement — jumping, arm flailing, foot stomping — can release tension. Does it really work?

item.title: What to Know About Glyphosate, the Weed Killer Potentially Linked to Cancer
item.description: Four out of 5 Americans over age 6 have measurable levels of glyphosate in their urine. Is this cause for concern as the U.S. boosts glyphosate production to make more of the herbicide Roundup?

item.title: Is Microdosing Ozempic or Other GLP-1s Effective for Weight Loss?
item.description: There’s no evidence yet that supports taking smaller doses of GLP-1s than recommended. Learn the risks of this approach to weight management.

item.title: What Is Parkinson’s Disease? Symptoms, Causes, Diagnosis, Treatment, and Prevention
item.description: Causes and symptoms of Parkinson’s disease can vary from person to person. While there is no cure, medications and treatments can help.
